name: pluto
description: Use TalentPluto's live recruiting workflows, privacy-filtered candidate discovery, bulk candidate work-email enrichment, small lookup of LinkedIn profiles, medium lookup with derived employment-company intelligence, heavy lookup adding cited public-web findings, client-shared candidate rubric creation and full-replacement editing with per-company preferences and priorities, candidate-to-Team DNA comparison, 0-100 candidate scoring against Team DNA and a supplied job description, outbound campaigns using an authorized Gmail inbox belonging to the requester or a coworker, or Pluto-managed delivery, Ashby ATS sourcing with job-driven search, ATS dedupe, and reviewed candidate export through the user's own Ashby MCP connection, and privacy-thresholded market snapshots through a stable, authenticated Pluto connection.

interface.shortDescription: Use TalentPluto recruiting, rubric, outbound, and market tools.
interface.longDescription: Connect once to use TalentPluto's live recruiting, candidate-email enrichment, LinkedIn profile enrichment, deep candidate enrichment with derived employment-company intelligence, full candidate enrichment adding cited public-web findings, client-shared candidate rubric creation and full-replacement editing with preferred and avoided company priorities, candidate-to-Team DNA comparison, 0-100 candidate scoring against Team DNA and a supplied job description, reviewable outbound campaigns using an authorized Gmail inbox belonging to the requester or a coworker, or Pluto-managed delivery, confirmed campaign cancellation, Ashby ATS sourcing alongside the user's own Ashby MCP connection, and market-insight workflows in Codex. Pluto advertises its current tools and input contracts from its MCP server, and consequential actions require explicit user direction.
defaultPrompt: Use Pluto to help with this recruiting task.
Find AI engineers with 1+ years of professional experience in New York.
Find people who match this pasted job description.
Give me a directional US market snapshot for engineering talent.
How many Pluto credits do I have left, and when do they reset?
Ask whether the selected in-network candidate's recorded preference is compatible with a $180,000 annual base salary.
Get and verify the available emails for the candidates I selected.
Get the full public profiles for the LinkedIn profile URLs I supplied.
Deep-enrich the LinkedIn profiles I selected with professional profiles and derived employment-company intelligence.
How does the background of the candidate I supplied overlap with our Team DNA?
Create or edit a candidate scoring rubric with preferred and avoided companies at high, medium, or low priority, show the complete proposed contents, and save only after I confirm the exact proposal.
Score the candidate I selected against our Team DNA and this job description.
Source candidates for my Ashby role and add the ones I pick to that job in Ashby.

Create a campaign for the candidates I selected. Prepare any missing recipient emails, ask once whether I want a saved template or custom content, then show one complete editable review for confirmation.
Cancel my outbound campaign for the payments role.
Continue with the candidate and role I selected in Pluto.
